status.title: CodexBar
status.info: Every provider enabled in CodexBar gets its own card in the usage page.
status.missingHint: The plugin looks for codexbar on PATH, then for the CLI inside CodexBar.app, then for the path below. Until one of those runs, the usage page has nothing to show.
status.providersHint_one: {{count}} provider enabled. Turning a provider on or off in CodexBar needs a plugin reload.
status.providersHint_other: {{count}} providers enabled. Turning a provider on or off in CodexBar needs a plugin reload.
status.providersEmpty: No provider is enabled in CodexBar. Enable one, then reload this plugin.

cliPath.title: Command line tool path
cliPath.info: Only used when codexbar is not on PATH and CodexBar.app is not in /Applications.
cliPath.label: CLI path
cliPath.hint: Full path to the CodexBar CLI. After changing it, reload the plugin so its providers are registered again.
cliPath.done: Saved. Reload the plugin to pick up a different provider list.
